info.timeAllocation:
Study hour (150h)

= 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description: This course provides knowledge of all basic sociological research methods as well as understanding of specific communication research and assessment instruments. As a result, the students will gain a practical understanding of research, evaluation in academic and professional settings. The course program includes practical acquaintance with contemporary media and social networks monitoring systems.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

clos.loDetails: To explain the nature of research in communication field and its process with different steps.
To distinguish different research methods in communication and select the most appropriate one for their research problems.
To apply qualitative research methods in communication field.
To apply quantitative research methods in communication field.
To create report and presentation to communicate their research project
To design and conduct a communication research project to ensure validity and reliablity and avoid ethical issues.
To respect research ethics and conduct communication research in an ethical way
